nodes.description: Mis-splicing of COL11A1 yields transcripts that cannot contribute a normal alpha-1 chain to the collagen XI heterotrimer. The outcome differs by variant - the two intron 4 acceptor-site lesions produce different splicing products despite hitting the same site - so the consequence is shared but reached by more than one transcript route, rather than a single defined aberrant species.

evidence.reference_title: Aberrant COL11A1 splicing causes prelingual autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss in the DFNA37 locus.
evidence.snippet: the c.652-1G>C variant affects the same intron 4 canonical splice site originally reported in the DFNA37 family (c.652-2A>C) but elicits a different splicing outcome

nodes.description: The reported DFNA37 variants sit on canonical splice sites of COL11A1 - c.652-2A>C and c.652-1G>C at the intron 4 acceptor, and c.4338+2T>C at a donor site. They are not missense changes in the triple-helical domain but lesions in the splicing signal itself, and the effect on RNA splicing was confirmed in vitro rather than predicted. Notably, the two intron 4 variants strike the same canonical site yet elicit different splicing outcomes, so the transcript consequence is not fixed by the position alone. The splice-site route is not the only one reported: a heterozygous COL11A1 missense variant has also been described in DFNA37 hearing loss, and such an allele would not disrupt a splicing signal at all.

nodes.description: Considered where thresholds progress beyond useful benefit from amplification. Reported DFNA37 severity ranges from mild to moderate-to-severe, so candidacy is individual rather than expected for the genotype. No DFNA37-specific implantation outcome data were found.

Collagen XI is a structural constituent of the cochlear extracellular matrix, including the tectorial membrane whose mechanical properties set how hair-cell stereocilia are deflected. A shortfall of normal alpha-1 chains is the proposed route from the transcript defect to impaired mechanotransduction. This step is inferred from the established role of collagen XI in auditory function rather than demonstrated in DFNA37 cochlear tissue, which is not available.

nodes.description: Conventional hearing aids are the first-line intervention for the mild to moderate loss reported in most DFNA37 families. Management follows general practice for autosomal dominant nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss; nothing about it is DFNA37-specific and no genotype-specific outcome data exist.
Onset is early. The index family was described as early-onset progressive mild hearing impairment; the two German families were explicitly prelingual.
